en: Gargoyles are powerful creatures. Use archers and special moves

Oh, you must be merfolk!

<< Gargoyle Coast >>\nWipe out the gargoyles.
Ugh... I'm going back first.
See? I told you it's dangerous alone!
Hmph...! So you won't help me, is that it?
Well... it's not that...
it would cause trouble.

<< The Broken Seal >>\nDefeat the Imperial troops who slipped onto the Magic Isle.
Nature's balance has been badly harmed lately, so the spirits are running mad
it seems.
The water spirit Marid and the fire golem are fighting.

there's no other way.

<< Mermaid Island Coast >>\nBreak through the battling spirits and reach the far shore.

<< Castle Pandragon >>
Already...
six years have passed...
We must avenge Father and our brothers!
This is only the beginning. First we retake Castle Pandragon,
then if we fight the weakened Empire, we have a good chance.
All right, enough talk. Let's attack!
Magic armor can't be used inside the castle.
<< Castle Pandragon >>\nDefeat the Imperial garrison and retake Castle Pandragon!
At last, we've taken back Castle Pandragon...
Thank you, Locarno.
It's all thanks to all of you.
Well done, Siren.
Does it feel good?
No. This is only the beginning.
Now... I could die without regret.
Don't say such weak things!
The battle with the Empire starts now!
Now you are every inch the heir of Pandragon!
We won, sister!
Ha ha ha! The Empire hasn't long left now!
This is Pandragon's treasure found in the castle: the 'Crown of Supremacy'.
Now, Princess, as Queen of Pandragon, by the will of the Twelve Gods
it is your duty to bring the Empire to justice.
I can't do it without all of you.
Let's join our strength once more and raise the banner of Silver Arrow!
Long live Pandragon!!!
Silver Arrow forever!
Long live Princess Iyolin!!!
Princess, the enemy seems to be after Commander Van Dyck.
Please guard Commander Van Dyck.
I'll take the heads of their officers.
Understood, Duran.
Commander Van Dyck!
The return of Silver Arrow... the restoration of Pandragon... Is this how it all ends...
Lord Erich!
Don't worry, sister!
Is the dream of restoring Pandragon to be shattered like this...
Not thanks to us; it's because we all fought together.
In any case, the Empire's momentum is broken, so let's all join forces
and attack the Empire while we can.
Silver Arrow is reborn!
<< Siege of Astania >>\nDefeat the Imperial army attacking Astania and protect Van Dyck.
To keep losses down, it's best to go for the enemy commander,
I think.
Is the Grand Duke safe?
I heard he escaped safely under Garius's protection.
The power of magic armor is fearsome.
<< Astania >>\nRetake Castle Astania from the Empire.
Imperial ironclad troops.
Their defence will be tough.
At last, Garad has fallen too.
Castle Garad fell more easily than expected.
Garad's guardian magic armor, Ogremesser, was destroyed before we stormed the castle,
so it was much easier.
If they had held out inside the castle walls, we'd have had a much harder
time.
Somehow I feel I've been here before.
So now we enter the Imperial homeland?
We have no choice but to fall back for now...
<< Advance on Garad >>\nTake Castle Garad.
I agree. You should think this through carefully...
Even if it's a trap, I have no choice but to go.
The princess is the heart and soul of Pandragon.
If anything happens to her, the dream of restoring Pandragon...
But it's still too dangerous.
If my sister were here, she'd say the same.
The Black Prince is one thing, but I hear that man Beradin is not
someone to be trusted...
My mind is made up.
GS!
You can't.
Farewell, everyone.
We'll have to trust the Black Prince.
Aah!
It's been a long time, Rashid.
Brother... are you...
The past can never be undone. I am only Crow.
More importantly, the Black Prince now is a fake.
What?
I was once defeated by him.
I've never forgotten it for a moment since.
The Black Prince I saw in the Dark Castle today was not the Black Prince
of that day.
Surely... no...
It's a trap after all.
But why...!

Now, I'm here, so free Iyolin as promised.
... Surely...
Wh...what?
I... Iyolin...
Filthy...
Is this how low the Black Prince has sunk?
So for all the rumours of a god, he was merely 'strong'?
Don't make me laugh...
... Fine! Come at me!
Ugh, my head is spinning.
Beradin...... Irene...
Why on earth am I here?
And why are these people attacking me?
Yes... Beradin betrayed me.
That night I crashed with the airship......
Much seems to have happened since then...
but I can't remember any of it.
First, let's get out of here.
Before I sweep up the Pandragon rabble, I'll punish the traitors!
Beradin!!!!
And Princess Irene!
You... are a fake.
So... then the real Black Prince...?
So that's how it was...
Ugh... my head...
Aaaargh-!
Ugh... my head is splitting.
Irene...... You betrayed me!
Ugh, where am I?
And who are these people?
Heh heh heh. You'd challenge the Black Prince?
Demon sword Asura!!!
Show them your power!
This is the true power of the Black Prince!
But where have my men gone?
To take back the Empire from Beradin, I need their help!
Right......
The Thirteen Dark Gods, sealed away long ago.
Yes, before Beradin struck, I had found clues to where they were sealed.
I had.
This sword will lead me there.
Demon sword Asura!!!

The legend of the only man who fought the Black Prince one on one.

I can't believe it. That energy just now... was the highest-level dark magic

The power of the holy sword?

Come to think of it, my body feels full of a strange energy.
Anyway, we have the holy sword, so let's return to Dagal.
We've wiped out the enemy!

We're from the mainland.

The truth is......
We're looking for a sorcerer who can control the kraken, to attack the
Blueseed pirates.
If possible, could you help us......

<< Citadel of the Sky >>\nWipe out the dragon-tooth soldiers.
What room is this?
I'm not sure, but it looks like the oracle in the old legends.
An oracle?
An oracle is where the gods passed their messages and will to humans.
So this is...
Ancient letters are carved on the stone tablet.
We, one hundred Arcanes, aboard the hyperspace star-jump ship Odyssey,
reached our target star system.
Hyperspace...?
I'm not sure either, but I'll keep deciphering.
We Arcanes, who studied star jumps,
found a star system much like ours two million light years across the universe,
and out of curiosity about new worlds and life, we began a vast project
at last.
What people are these 'Arcanes'?
I don't know, but by our understanding it's hard to grasp...
I'll keep going for now.
The plan was to marshal all of our Arcane science
to build a hyperspace system that could leap millions of light years at once,
the greatest project in the history of planet Arche.
Uh-oh... the space is growing unstable again!
It looks like we'll teleport again.
<< Arche >>
There are letters here too.
But even after long research, no ship was built with enough speed
or able to leap through space.
A ship?
It seems to mean a huge airship...
Then we turned our attention to the latent psychic powers within us,
and to the powers we ourselves possessed,
and began researching ways to amplify them.
Psychic powers?
Something like magic.
A well-trained Arcane
could leap short distances through space.
But reaching a cluster two million light years away needed another way,
and the research split into two main paths:
a physical method using ESP amplifiers, and one using genetic engineering,
a biochemical method.
After decades of research, the hundred of us, engineered with the strongest psychic genes,
were born as test subjects, and the ship to amplify our powers,
the hyperspace jump ship Odyssey, was completed.
In the Arche year 237,652 we finally attempted the hyperspace jump,
and soon reached our target star system.
The Odyssey's computer found the planet in this system most like Arche,
and we named it Antaria, after our home system.
That's what we called it.
It looks like we'll teleport again.
Where on earth did the gods come from?
<< Odyssey >>
At last, it seems deciphered.
Once settled on Antaria, we first faced the side effects of the space jump
on our bodies.
Of our hundred, seventy-five fell into suspended animation from the shock of the jump,
and the other twenty-five suffered serious after-effects.
First our psychic powers grew badly weaker, and our fertility declined.
Overcoming all this, we waited on Antaria for the follow-up Arche expedition
that was to arrive soon after.
But the promised year passed, then ten, then centuries,
and the expedition never came.
Centuries?
Yet as time passed our bodies did not age,
and the cause of our weakened fertility became clear.
Our genes, engineered from the start, were very alike to begin with,
and the gravity waves of the jump caused strange changes in our cells.
That was the cause.
Still hoping for the expedition, we bred the plants and animals
brought from Arche here, and some of us created animals
with genes much like our own.
In time they multiplied rapidly, and they seemed to revere us,
their makers, who held such great power.
But as these followers appeared, the twenty-five of us who survived split into two
factions.
This is about the creation of humans.
One was the physics faction, led by me, Prios.
Prios! The Absolute God of the Twelve!
The other, the biology faction, was led by the vice-captain, Deimos.
At first, a small quarrel among the humans who followed us
grew into open war between us, and the feud lasted for centuries.
It went on.
To make up for our weakened powers, we of the physics faction built psychic amplifier weapons
called magic armor, and pressed Deimos's people hard.
But... who knew that was where the trouble began...
Pushed back by the magic armor, Deimos's people used their deep knowledge of the body
to change their own bodies and developed a new power that drew out great strength,
and the great clash between our amplified powers had unexpected
results.
It sounds like the story of Ragnarok.
I can't believe it. That we were made by people from another world...
The great clash woke our old comrades sleeping in the Odyssey,
and with unbelievably strong psychic powers,
they destroyed friend and foe alike.
Magic armor and our new powers were useless against them,
so to fight another day we sealed ourselves away with the Odyssey
beneath this sea, far from the continent.
But we left clues to this place for the humans who followed us,
so whoever reads this must be their descendant.
This world is now in a very unstable state.
And we must return home.
With our strongest magic armor, able to face the destroyers,
we enter a group sleep. It links the minds of the twelve of us
in a long and tedious process.
Our creations! You are our children.
We trust in the will that brought you here.
Use this Odyssey to fulfil your purpose.
But this is all we can do to help you.
At least until we wake again...
...Prios, Captain of the Odyssey
